entry.title: Navistar International Corp: Entered riskiest 5%
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk entered the riskiest 5%: riskier than 97% of filers with the 10-Q filed 2021-03-09 (was 90%).

entry.title: Navistar International Corp: Going-concern wording
entry.summary: The new 10-K says events "raise substantial doubt" (going-concern wording); the previous 10-K did not.

entry.title: Navistar International Corp: Risk jump
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk rose from riskier than 59% to 88% of filers with the 10-Q filed 2017-03-07.

entry.title: Navistar International Corp: SEC accounting case
entry.summary: Named in SEC Accounting and Auditing Enforcement Release AAER-3165.
